content.json:
# Azure FinOps Monitor
Spend, savings and forecast for all selected subscriptions, organized the FinOps way: **see the spend → find the savings → plan and track delivery**.

> **Pages:** 1a Executive Summary · 1b Cost Analytics Layers · 2 Azure Services (service-wise spend and deep dive) · 3 Compute & AKS · 4 Storage · 5 Databases · 6 Network · 7 PaaS & Apps · 8 Monitoring & Security · 9 Savings Plan & Tracker · 10 Recommendations · 11 Governance.
>
> *Subscriptions* filters inventory and Advisor savings. *Cost scope* is used for spend and forecast: choose **All** (every subscription under the picked billing account) or one subscription.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.description: Inventory, savings and hygiene checks use these subscriptions.

parameters.name: CostScope
parameters.label: Cost scope (All, or pick one)
parameters.description: All = every subscription under the Billing account picked next to it (or the tenant root management group if no billing account). Pick a single subscription to see only that one, for example a Dev/Test or Pay-As-You-Go subscription.
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| project value = '__ALL__', label = 'All subscriptions (billing account)', o = 0
| union (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = strcat('Subscription: ', name), o = 1
)
| union (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == 'microsoft.management/managementgroups' and name != tenantId
    | project value = id, label = strcat('Management group: ', tostring(properties.displayName)), o = 2
)
| union (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | take 1
    | project value = strcat('/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/', tenantId), label = 'Tenant root management group (not accepted by all agreements)', o = 3
)
| summarize arg_min(o, label) by value
| sort by o asc, label asc
| project value, label, selected = (o == 0)

parameters.name: BillingAccountPick
parameters.label: Billing account (used when Cost scope = All)
parameters.description: Use this when the management-group Cost scope fails. Pick your Enterprise Agreement or MCA billing account to read cost for every subscription under it. Leave empty to use Cost scope.
parameters.query: {"version": "ARMEndpoint/1.0", "data": null, "headers": [], "method": "GET", "path": "/providers/Microsoft.Billing/billingAccounts", "urlParams": [{"key": "api-version", "value": "2020-05-01"}], "batchDisabled": false, "transformers": [{"type": "jsonpath", "settings": {"tablePath": "$.value[*]", "columns": [{"path": "$.id", "columnid": "value"}, {"path": "$.properties.displayName", "columnid": "label"}]}}]}

parameters.name: BillingProfilePath
parameters.label: Billing profile path (optional, MCA)
parameters.description: Optional. If the billing account scope is rejected, paste a billing profile path here (the list of profile paths is in the 12-month check section). Leave empty otherwise.

parameters.name: ScopeOverride
parameters.label: Scope override (optional, paste a scope path)
parameters.description: For testing. Paste a full scope, for example /subscriptions/<id>, /providers/Microsoft.Billing/billingAccounts/<id>, or a billing profile path. It replaces every other scope choice. Clear it to go back.

parameters.name: CostScopeEffective
parameters.label: Cost scope in use
parameters.description: All: the billing account if one is picked, otherwise the tenant root management group. Otherwise the single subscription or management group picked in Cost scope.
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend Ov = '{ScopeOverride}', Ba = '{BillingAccountPick}', Bp = '{BillingProfilePath}', Cs = '{CostScope}'
| extend HasOv = isnotempty(Ov) and not(Ov startswith '{'), HasBa = isnotempty(Ba) and not(Ba startswith '{'), HasBp = isnotempty(Bp) and not(Bp startswith '{')
| project value = case(HasOv, Ov, Cs == '__ALL__' and HasBp, Bp, Cs == '__ALL__' and HasBa, Ba, Cs == '__ALL__', strcat('/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/', tenantId), Cs),
          label = case(HasOv, 'Scope override (pasted above)', Cs == '__ALL__' and HasBp, 'All subscriptions: billing profile', Cs == '__ALL__' and HasBa, 'All subscriptions: billing account', Cs == '__ALL__', 'All subscriptions: tenant root management group (no billing account picked)', 'Single scope picked in Cost scope')

parameters.name: CostType
parameters.label: Cost view
parameters.description: Actual (invoice) works at every scope and is lighter. Amortized spreads reservation purchases over their term and is not accepted at some billing scopes.

parameters.name: TrendMonths
parameters.label: Trend period
parameters.description: Used by detailed trend charts. Longer periods use more of Azure's Cost Management query quota.

parameters.name: FYStartMonth
parameters.label: Fiscal year starts
parameters.description: First month of the client's fiscal year. FY names use the year the fiscal year ends (e.g. FY27 = the year ending in 2027).

parameters.name: TrendStart
parameters.query:

| project value = format_datetime(startofmonth(now(), -({TrendMonths} - 1)), 'yyyy-MM-dd')

content.json:
**Cost scope in use:** {CostScopeEffective}  
*Source:* {CostScopeEffective:label}

> **If cost tiles show `Management group ... does not have any valid subscriptions`:** keep **Cost scope = All** and pick your **Billing account** (Enterprise Agreement or MCA), or set **Cost scope** to a single subscription (needed for Dev/Test and Pay-As-You-Go subscriptions, which are not under the billing account).
>
> **If tiles show `429 Too many requests` or `query failed`:** Azure Cost Management is limiting calls, and billing-account scope is limited most. Stop refreshing, wait 5 minutes, then reload the page once. Executive Summary part 1 loads its cost values one after another (30-60 seconds); part 2 loads only the module you pick. Switching **Cost view** to *Actual* is lighter than *Amortized*.
>
> **If tiles say `No query was specified` or show blank:** the first cost query (*L12Spend*) has not succeeded yet. The rest waits for it.
>
> **Microsoft Customer Agreement:** if the billing account scope fails, paste a **Billing profile path** in the box next to it (the list is under the 12-month check). Cost view defaults to *Actual*, which every scope accepts.
>
> **Isolating the problem:** (1) set **Cost scope** to one subscription that is on your Enterprise or Customer Agreement; if the status tiles load, cost reading works and only the billing account scope is blocked. (2) If nothing loads even for one subscription, the cost role or the billing *view charges* setting is the cause. Read the message in the **12-month check** box to tell which.

## Executive Summary
Everything leadership needs on one page: total spend, identified savings and savings %, the fiscal-year forecast, the 12-month spend trend with the top spend drivers, and the top savings by Azure service.

> Spend values come from **Cost Management** and load one after another (about 30–60 seconds) to stay within Azure's query limits. If a tile shows *429* or *query failed*, wait a moment and click its refresh icon. Savings come from **Azure Advisor** and are estimates to validate before committing.

content.json:
**Cost data not loading? Read the message in the box below** (it runs the same call as the first value).

| Message contains | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `Management group ... does not have any valid subscriptions` | The tenant-root group is not accepted | Set **Cost scope = All** and pick the **Billing account** (or a single subscription) |
| `429` or `Too many requests` | Azure is throttling cost calls | Stop refreshing, wait 5 minutes, reload once |
| `Authorization`, `403` or `does not have access` | Missing cost role at this scope | Ask for Billing Reader or Cost Management Reader at the billing account |
| `Amortized` or `not supported` | The cost view is not accepted at this scope | Set **Cost view = Actual** |
| `date`, `range`, `older than` | The period is too long for this scope | Set **Trend period = Last 3 months** |
| `BadRequest` with a billing account path | MCA account scope refused | Pick a **Billing profile** in the box next to the billing account |

content.title: Cost Management check: last 12 full months (the call behind Total Azure spend). If this errors, the message explains why.
content.noDataMessage: No cost returned for the last 12 full months.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend L12 = coalesce(todouble('{L12Spend}'), todouble('{ManualL12}')), L3 = coalesce(todouble('{L3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualL3}')), FY = coalesce(todouble('{FY26Actual}'), todouble('{ManualYTD}')), P3 = coalesce(todouble('{P3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualP3}')), AL12 = todouble('{L12Spend}'), AL3 = todouble('{L3Spend}'), AFY = todouble('{FY26Actual}'), AP3 = todouble('{P3Spend}')
| project Metrics = pack_array(
            strcat('12 months: ', iff(isnotnull(AL12), 'loaded', iff(isnotnull(L12), 'entered manually', 'NOT loaded'))),
            strcat('3 months: ', iff(isnotnull(AL3), 'loaded', iff(isnotnull(L3), 'entered manually', 'NOT loaded'))),
            strcat('Year to date: ', iff(isnotnull(AFY), 'loaded', iff(isnotnull(FY), 'entered manually', 'NOT loaded'))),
            strcat('Last year: ', iff(isnotnull(AP3), 'loaded', iff(isnotnull(P3), 'entered manually', 'NOT loaded')))),
          Values = pack_array(round(L12, 0), round(L3, 0), round(FY, 0), round(P3, 0))
| mv-expand Metric = Metrics to typeof(string), Value = Values to typeof(real)
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Cost data load status (values load one after another, 30 to 60 seconds)
content.noDataMessage: Status unavailable.

content.json: > **Cost values not loading?** The forecast can run on numbers you type here (from the client's invoices) until Cost Management loads. Automatic values always win over typed ones. The *Source* column and the status tiles show which are in use.

parameters.name: ManualL12
parameters.label: Last 12 full months spend (optional)
parameters.description: Use only if Cost Management cannot load. Total from invoices, numbers only, same currency and cost basis as the forecast.

parameters.name: ManualL3
parameters.label: Last 3 full months spend (optional)
parameters.description: Drives the run-rate forecast for FY2026 to FY2028. Numbers only.

parameters.name: ManualYTD
parameters.label: This year to date spend (optional)
parameters.description: Spend from the start of the fiscal year to yesterday. Numbers only.

parameters.name: ManualP3
parameters.label: Same 3 months last year (optional)
parameters.description: Only used to estimate growth. Leave empty for 0% growth.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend State = tostring(properties.state)
| summarize Total = count(), Enabled = countif(State =~ 'Enabled'), Other = countif(State !~ 'Enabled')
| extend R = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Subscriptions in scope (all)', 'Value', todouble(Total), 'O', 0),
    pack('Metric', 'Enabled', 'Value', todouble(Enabled), 'O', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'Disabled, warned or other', 'Value', todouble(Other), 'O', 2))
| mv-expand R
| project Metric = tostring(R.Metric), Value = todouble(R.Value), O = toint(R.O)
| sort by O asc
| project Metric, Value
content.noDataMessage: No subscriptions visible.
content.title: Subscriptions you can see (all states)

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend State = tostring(properties.state), Offer = tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId)

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
| extend ImpactedResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId))
| extend ImpRG = tostring(split(ImpactedResourceId, '/')[4])
| extend IsSubLevel = isempty(ImpactedResourceId) or isempty(ImpRG)
| extend ImpactedField = tolower(tostring(properties.impactedField))
| extend Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution)
| extend SolLow = tolower(Solution)
| extend RRT = tolower(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.reservedResourceType))
| extend RecSku = tostring(coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.vmSize), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.sku), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.displaySKU)))
| extend RecRegion = tolower(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.region))
| extend Term = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.term)
| extend Qty = tostring(coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.displayQty), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.qty)))
| extend Impact = tostring(properties.impact)
| extend MonthlySavings = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)
| summarize arg_max(MonthlySavings, ImpactedField, ImpRG, Solution, SolLow, RRT, Term, Qty, Impact, IsSubLevel) by subscriptionId, ImpactedResourceId, SolKey = tolower(tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution)), RecSku, RecRegion
| extend AnnualSavings = MonthlySavings * 12
| extend CommitService = case(
    SolLow has 'savings plan', 'Virtual Machines',
    RRT has 'virtualmachine' or SolLow has_any ('virtual machine reserved', 'vm reserved'), 'Virtual Machines',
    RRT has 'blob' or SolLow has 'blob storage', 'Storage Accounts',
    RRT has 'manageddisk' or SolLow has 'disk', 'Managed Disks & Snapshots',
    RRT has 'sql' or SolLow has 'sql', 'Azure SQL',
    RRT has 'postgres' or SolLow has 'postgresql', 'PostgreSQL',
    RRT has 'mysql' or SolLow has 'mysql', 'MySQL',
    RRT has 'cosmos' or SolLow has 'cosmos', 'Cosmos DB',
    RRT has 'redis' or SolLow has 'redis', 'Redis Cache',
    RRT has 'appservice' or SolLow has 'app service', 'App Service',
    RRT has_any ('dataexplorer', 'databricks', 'synapse') or SolLow has_any ('data explorer', 'databricks', 'synapse'), 'Data & Analytics',
    'Other commitments')
| extend Service = iff(IsSubLevel, CommitService, case(
    ImpactedField == 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets' and tolower(ImpRG) startswith 'mc_', 'AKS',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'), 'Storage Accounts',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'), 'Virtual Machines',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots'), 'Managed Disks & Snapshots',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'), 'AKS',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.web/serverfarms', 'microsoft.web/sites'), 'App Service',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.sql/servers', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools', 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances'), 'Azure SQL',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers'), 'PostgreSQL',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers'), 'MySQL',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts'), 'Cosmos DB',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.cache/redisenterprise'), 'Redis Cache',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces', 'microsoft.insights/components'), 'Log Analytics & Monitor',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/natgateways', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.network/bastionhosts', 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles', 'microsoft.network/frontdoors'), 'Networking',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults'), 'Backup & Recovery',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.databricks/workspaces', 'microsoft.synapse/workspaces', 'microsoft.kusto/clusters', 'microsoft.datafactory/factories'), 'Data & Analytics',
    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces', 'microsoft.search/searchservices'), 'Azure AI & ML',
    'Other services'))
| extend Lever = case(
    SolLow has_any ('reserved instance', 'reservation', 'savings plan'), 'Rate: commitments (RI / Savings Plan)',
    SolLow has 'hybrid benefit', 'Rate: Azure Hybrid Benefit',
    SolLow has_any ('delete', 'unattached', 'idle', 'orphaned', 'unused', 'shutdown', 'shut down', 'snapshot', 'retention'), 'Usage: remove waste',
    SolLow has_any ('right-size', 'resize', 'underutilized', 'scale down', 'sku', 'consolidat'), 'Usage: rightsize',
    'Architecture & modernization')
| extend ResourceName = iff(IsSubLevel, '(subscription-level)', tostring(split(ImpactedResourceId, '/')[-1]))
| summarize Annual = sum(AnnualSavings)
| extend Today = startofday(now()), L12 = coalesce(todouble('{L12Spend}'), todouble('{ManualL12}')), L3 = coalesce(todouble('{L3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualL3}')), P3 = coalesce(todouble('{P3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualP3}'))
| extend L3Days = (startofmonth(now()) - startofmonth(now(), -3)) / 1d
| extend Daily = iff(L3Days > 0, L3 / L3Days, real(null))
| extend AutoG = iff(P3 > 0, L3 / P3 - 1.0, 0.0)
| extend G = iff('{Growth}' == 'auto', iff(AutoG > 1.0, 1.0, iff(AutoG < -0.5, -0.5, AutoG)), todouble('{Growth}') / 100.0)
| extend Planned = Annual * {ForecastRealization} / 100.0
| extend Next12 = Daily * 365.0 * pow(1.0 + G, 0.5)
| extend R = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Total Azure spend, last 12 full months', 'Value', todouble(L12), 'O', 0),
    pack('Metric', 'Average monthly spend', 'Value', todouble(L12 / 12.0), 'O', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'Azure savings identified (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Annual), 'O', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'Planned savings at {ForecastRealization}% (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Planned), 'O', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Annual forecast: next 12 months', 'Value', todouble(Next12), 'O', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Next 12 months with savings plan', 'Value', todouble(Next12 - Planned), 'O', 5))
| mv-expand R
| project Metric = tostring(R.Metric), Value = todouble(R.Value), O = toint(R.O)
| where isnotnull(Value)
| sort by O asc
| project Metric, Value

### Year-on-year spend: FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026
FY2024 and FY2025 are history (actual spend). **FY2026 is actual to date plus a forecast for the rest of the year**, using the same growth assumption as the forecast above. The table shows the difference from the previous year.

> Cost Management keeps a limited history. If a year shows *No data*, enter that year's total from your invoices in the boxes above and the comparison fills in.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend Today = startofday(now()), S = {FYStartMonth}, L3 = coalesce(todouble('{L3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualL3}')), P3 = coalesce(todouble('{P3Spend}'), todouble('{ManualP3}'))
| extend L3Days = (startofmonth(now()) - startofmonth(now(), -3)) / 1d
| extend Daily = iff(L3Days > 0, L3 / L3Days, real(null))
| extend AutoG = iff(P3 > 0, L3 / P3 - 1.0, 0.0)
| extend G = iff('{Growth}' == 'auto', iff(AutoG > 1.0, 1.0, iff(AutoG < -0.5, -0.5, AutoG)), todouble('{Growth}') / 100.0)
| extend Start24 = startofmonth(todatetime(strcat(tostring(2000 + 24 - iff(S == 1, 0, 1)), '-01-01')), S - 1)
| extend End24 = startofmonth(Start24, 12) - 1d
| extend Val24 = coalesce(todouble('{FY24Manual}'), todouble('{FY24Actual}'))
| extend Src24 = iff(isnotnull(todouble('{FY24Manual}')), 'Entered manually', iff(isnotnull(todouble('{FY24Actual}')), 'Cost API', 'No data'))
| extend Act24 = iff(Start24 < Today, Val24, 0.0)
| extend RemFrom24 = iff(Start24 > Today, Start24, Today)
| extend Rem24 = iff(End24 >= RemFrom24, (End24 - RemFrom24) / 1d + 1.0, 0.0)
| extend Mid24 = iff(Rem24 > 0, ((RemFrom24 + (End24 - RemFrom24) / 2) - Today) / 1d / 30.44, 0.0)
| extend Fc24 = iff(Rem24 > 0, Rem24 * Daily * pow(1.0 + G, Mid24 / 12.0), 0.0)
| extend Tot24 = Act24 + Fc24
| extend Start25 = startofmonth(todatetime(strcat(tostring(2000 + 25 - iff(S == 1, 0, 1)), '-01-01')), S - 1)
| extend End25 = startofmonth(Start25, 12) - 1d
| extend Val25 = coalesce(todouble('{FY25Manual}'), todouble('{FY25Actual}'))
| extend Src25 = iff(isnotnull(todouble('{FY25Manual}')), 'Entered manually', iff(isnotnull(todouble('{FY25Actual}')), 'Cost API', 'No data'))
| extend Act25 = iff(Start25 < Today, Val25, 0.0)
| extend RemFrom25 = iff(Start25 > Today, Start25, Today)
| extend Rem25 = iff(End25 >= RemFrom25, (End25 - RemFrom25) / 1d + 1.0, 0.0)
| extend Mid25 = iff(Rem25 > 0, ((RemFrom25 + (End25 - RemFrom25) / 2) - Today) / 1d / 30.44, 0.0)
| extend Fc25 = iff(Rem25 > 0, Rem25 * Daily * pow(1.0 + G, Mid25 / 12.0), 0.0)
| extend Tot25 = Act25 + Fc25
| extend Start26 = startofmonth(todatetime(strcat(tostring(2000 + 26 - iff(S == 1, 0, 1)), '-01-01')), S - 1)
| extend End26 = startofmonth(Start26, 12) - 1d
| extend Val26 = coalesce(real(null), coalesce(todouble('{FY26Actual}'), todouble('{ManualYTD}')))
| extend Src26 = iff(isnotnull(real(null)), 'Entered manually', iff(isnotnull(todouble('{FY26Actual}')), 'Cost API', iff(isnotnull(todouble('{ManualYTD}')), 'Entered manually', 'No data')))
| extend Act26 = iff(Start26 < Today, Val26, 0.0)
| extend RemFrom26 = iff(Start26 > Today, Start26, Today)
| extend Rem26 = iff(End26 >= RemFrom26, (End26 - RemFrom26) / 1d + 1.0, 0.0)
| extend Mid26 = iff(Rem26 > 0, ((RemFrom26 + (End26 - RemFrom26) / 2) - Today) / 1d / 30.44, 0.0)
| extend Fc26 = iff(Rem26 > 0, Rem26 * Daily * pow(1.0 + G, Mid26 / 12.0), 0.0)
| extend Tot26 = Act26 + Fc26
| extend R = pack_array(
    pack('N', 24, 'Start', Start24, 'End', End24, 'Src', Src24, 'Act', Act24, 'Fc', Fc24, 'Tot', Tot24, 'Rem', Rem24, 'Prev', real(null)),
    pack('N', 25, 'Start', Start25, 'End', End25, 'Src', Src25, 'Act', Act25, 'Fc', Fc25, 'Tot', Tot25, 'Rem', Rem25, 'Prev', Tot24),
    pack('N', 26, 'Start', Start26, 'End', End26, 'Src', Src26, 'Act', Act26, 'Fc', Fc26, 'Tot', Tot26, 'Rem', Rem26, 'Prev', Tot25))
| mv-expand R
| extend Tot = todouble(R.Tot), Prev = todouble(R.Prev)
| project ['Fiscal Year'] = strcat('FY', tostring(toint(R.N))),
    Period = strcat(format_datetime(todatetime(R.Start), 'yyyy-MM'), ' to ', format_datetime(todatetime(R.End), 'yyyy-MM')),
    Source = tostring(R.Src),
    Basis = case(isnull(Tot), 'No data', todouble(R.Rem) == 0, 'Actual', 'Actual to date + forecast'),
    ['Actual to Date'] = round(todouble(R.Act), 0), ['Forecast (remaining)'] = round(todouble(R.Fc), 0), ['Total'] = round(Tot, 0),
    ['Change vs previous FY'] = round(Tot - Prev, 0),
    ['Change %'] = iff(Prev > 0, round(100.0 * (Tot - Prev) / Prev, 1), real(null))
| where isnotnull(['Total'])
| project ['Fiscal Year'], ['Total']

content.json:
---
## Cost analytics layers
The 14 analytical layers built from the Cost Management data. Each section below shows the metric and how it is read. Cost tables load as you scroll to them; if one says *429*, wait a minute and click its Refresh.

| Analytics module | Metrics / information | Where below |
|---|---|---|
| Subscription analytics | Total monthly cost per subscription | 1 |
| Service analytics | Cost per Azure service | 2 |
| Resource analytics | Cost per individual resource | 3 |
| Resource group analytics | Cost by resource group | 4 |
| Monthly trend | Month-on-month cost variation | 5 |
| Cost anomaly | Unexpected increase or decrease | 6 |
| Cost forecast | Estimated end-of-month spend | 7 |
| Top spenders | Top 20 expensive services and resources | 2 and 3 |
| Cost distribution | Percentage of spend per service | 2 |
| Rate optimization | Reservations and Savings Plans | 8 |
| Tag analytics | Cost by application, team and owner | 9 |
| Region analytics | Cost by Azure region | 10 |
| Marketplace analytics | Third-party and Marketplace charges | 11 |
| License analytics | License and billing-related charges | 12 |

> Per-service percentages and month-over-month change per service are read from the charts below (hover for exact values); the Python report script produces them as calculated columns.
### 1. Subscription analytics: total monthly cost per subscription

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend LM = todouble('{LMSpend}'), PM = todouble('{PMSpend}')
| extend Pct = iff(PM > 0, round(100.0 * (LM - PM) / PM, 1), real(null))
| project Metrics = pack_array('Last month', 'Previous month', 'Change vs previous month', 'Change vs previous month (%)', 'Anomaly flag (1 = moved more than 15%)'),
          Values = pack_array(round(LM, 0), round(PM, 0), round(LM - PM, 0), Pct, iff(abs(Pct) > 15, 1.0, 0.0))
| mv-expand Metric = Metrics to typeof(string), Value = Values to typeof(real)
| project Metric, Value

content.json:
### 7. Cost forecast: estimated end-of-month spend
Run-rate: month-to-date spend divided by days of cost data, times days in the month. It assumes the rest of the month looks like the days so far, so treat it as an estimate. The fiscal-year forecast is at the top of this page.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend MTD = todouble('{MTDSpend}'), LM = todouble('{LMSpend}'), Elapsed = toreal(max_of(dayofmonth(now()) - 1, 1)), DIM = toreal(dayofmonth(endofmonth(now())))
| extend Forecast = MTD / Elapsed * DIM
| project Metrics = pack_array('Month to date', 'Days of cost data (through yesterday)', 'End-of-month forecast (run-rate)', 'Forecast vs last month (%)'),
          Values = pack_array(round(MTD, 0), Elapsed, round(Forecast, 0), iff(LM > 0, round(100.0 * (Forecast - LM) / LM, 1), real(null)))
| mv-expand Metric = Metrics to typeof(string), Value = Values to typeof(real)
| project Metric, Value
content.title: End-of-month forecast
content.noDataMessage: Waiting for cost data (see the cost scope note at the top).

| summarize Resources = count(), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId), Regions = dcount(location),
    ['Missing Owner Tag'] = countif(isempty(Owner)) by Service
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
    | extend ImpactedResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId))
    | extend ImpRG = tostring(split(ImpactedResourceId, '/')[4])
    | extend IsSubLevel = isempty(ImpactedResourceId) or isempty(ImpRG)
    | extend ImpactedField = tolower(tostring(properties.impactedField))
    | extend Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution)

    | extend RRT = tolower(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.reservedResourceType))

    | extend Impact = tostring(properties.impact)

        RRT has_any ('dataexplorer', 'databricks', 'synapse') or SolLow has_any ('data explorer', 'databricks', 'synapse'), 'Data & Analytics',
        'Other commitments')
    | extend Service = iff(IsSubLevel, CommitService, case(
        ImpactedField == 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets' and tolower(ImpRG) startswith 'mc_', 'AKS',
        ImpactedField in ('microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'), 'Storage Accounts',

        ImpactedField in ('microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers'), 'PostgreSQL',

content.json:
#### FinOps playbook: Storage Accounts
Lifecycle management rules (Hot → Cool after 30 days → Cold/Archive after 90–180), delete orphaned containers and old blob versions, LRS/ZRS for non-prod, reserved capacity for steady large volumes, review transaction-heavy accounts (Premium can be cheaper for very high transactions).

#### FinOps playbook: Virtual Machines
Rightsize on P95 CPU/memory over 30 days, auto-shutdown for dev/test, delete deallocated VMs no longer needed, Azure Hybrid Benefit for Windows/SQL, Reservations for steady SKUs and Savings Plan for changing SKUs, Spot VMs for batch.

#### FinOps playbook: Managed Disks & Snapshots
Delete unattached disks, keep snapshots incremental with a retention policy, Standard SSD for non-prod, right-size Premium disks to the IOPS actually used (or use Premium SSD v2).

#### FinOps playbook: AKS
Cluster autoscaler + KEDA, right-size pod requests/limits, Spot node pools for tolerant workloads, stop non-prod clusters out of hours, Reservations/Savings Plan on node VM sizes, Free tier for non-prod. Track cost per namespace.

#### FinOps playbook: App Service
Consolidate low-use apps onto fewer plans, delete empty plans and stopped apps, autoscale rules, Premium v3 reservations or Savings Plan for steady plans.

#### FinOps playbook: Azure SQL
Serverless with auto-pause for dev/test, elastic pools for many small DBs, right-size vCores to utilization, Azure Hybrid Benefit, reserved capacity for steady production.

#### FinOps playbook: PostgreSQL
Burstable tier for dev/test, stop/start schedules, right-size vCores and storage, reserved capacity for production.

#### FinOps playbook: MySQL
Burstable tier for dev/test, stop/start schedules, right-size vCores and storage, reserved capacity for production.

#### FinOps playbook: Cosmos DB
Autoscale throughput, serverless for spiky or low traffic, TTL on transient data, review indexing policy, reserved capacity for steady RU/s.

#### FinOps playbook: Redis Cache
Right-size tier to memory used, Basic/Standard for non-prod, reserved capacity for production caches.

#### FinOps playbook: Log Analytics & Monitor
Filter noisy tables at ingestion (DCRs), move verbose logs to Basic/Auxiliary plans, set per-table retention, use commitment tiers once ingestion is steady above ~100 GB/day.

#### FinOps playbook: Networking
Delete unattached public IPs and idle gateways, share hub firewalls instead of one per spoke, reduce cross-region and internet egress, review Front Door/CDN tiers.

#### FinOps playbook: Backup & Recovery
Match retention to policy (not 'forever'), LRS for non-prod vaults, remove backups of deleted VMs, archive tier for long-term recovery points.

#### FinOps playbook: Data & Analytics
Auto-terminate Databricks clusters, prefer job clusters over all-purpose, pause Synapse/ADX when idle, Databricks pre-purchase (DBCU) for steady use.

#### FinOps playbook: Azure AI & ML
Stop idle compute instances, min-nodes = 0 on clusters, choose the smallest model that meets quality, provisioned throughput reservations for steady token volume.

| extend ResourceName = iff(IsSubLevel, '(subscription-level)', tostring(split(ImpactedResourceId, '/')[-1]))

| where not(IsSubLevel)
| summarize Recommendations = count(), ['Top Recommendation'] = max(Solution), Risk = max(Impact), Lever = max(Lever),

    by subscriptionId, ['Resource Group'] = ImpRG, Resource = ResourceName, ['Resource Id'] = ImpactedResourceId
| top 10 by ['Annual Savings'] desc

    resourcecontainers
    | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name

| project Subscription, ['Resource Group'], Resource, ['Top Recommendation'], Lever, Risk, Recommendations, ['Monthly Savings'], ['Annual Savings'], ['Resource Id']

content.json:
## Storage Analysis: reservation vs lifecycle, before we commit
Advisor can suggest a storage reservation, but on a brownfield estate the real answer depends on **which** capacity the reservation covers and **what lifecycle rules will move** first. This tab answers:
1. How much do we spend on storage, and how is it trending year over year?
2. What part of that spend is capacity (reservation-eligible) versus transactions and egress (not eligible)?
3. Which accounts would a reservation actually cover (region, tier, redundancy)?
4. What happens to the numbers if we apply lifecycle management first?

content.json:
### What-if: lifecycle first, then reservation
The calculation starts from your **actual storage spend** for the last 12 months. Set the capacity share from the meter table, then your assumptions. The calculator shows why the two savings can't simply be added: once lifecycle rules move data to a cheaper tier, there is less Hot capacity left to reserve.

> All percentages are planning assumptions. Confirm prices on the Azure pricing page and validate access patterns before changing tiers.

parameters.name: CapShare
parameters.label: % of storage spend that is capacity (Data Stored)
parameters.description: Read this from the meter table above: Data Stored meters ÷ total storage spend.

parameters.name: LcMove
parameters.label: % capacity moved by lifecycle
parameters.description: Share of Hot data that is rarely read. Estimate from last-access tracking or blob inventory.

parameters.name: LcSave
parameters.label: % cheaper in target tier
parameters.description: Price drop from Hot to the target tier after read and early-deletion charges. Check current Azure pricing for your region.

parameters.name: RiCover
parameters.label: % of remaining capacity reserved
parameters.description: Reserve only the steady baseline. Sold per region, tier and redundancy in 100 TiB / 1 PiB blocks.

parameters.name: RiDisc
parameters.label: % reservation discount
parameters.description: Check the Azure pricing page for your region, tier and term.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend Total = todouble('{StorageSpend12}'), Share = todouble({CapShare}) / 100.0
| extend Spend = Total * Share, Move = todouble({LcMove}) / 100.0, Cheaper = todouble({LcSave}) / 100.0, Cover = todouble({RiCover}) / 100.0, Disc = todouble({RiDisc}) / 100.0
| extend Lifecycle = Spend * Move * Cheaper
| extend Reservation = (Spend - Lifecycle) * Cover * Disc
| extend Combined = Lifecycle + Reservation, Naive = Spend * Move * Cheaper + Spend * Cover * Disc
| extend R = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Storage spend, last 12 full months', 'Value', todouble(Total), 'O', 0),
    pack('Metric', 'Capacity spend used in calculation', 'Value', todouble(Spend), 'O', 1),
    pack('Metric', '1. Lifecycle saving (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Lifecycle), 'O', 2),
    pack('Metric', '2. Reservation saving, sized after lifecycle (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Reservation), 'O', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Realistic combined saving (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Combined), 'O', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Combined as % of storage spend', 'Value', todouble(iff(Total > 0, round(100.0 * Combined / Total, 1), real(null))), 'O', 5),
    pack('Metric', 'Naive sum if analysed separately', 'Value', todouble(Naive), 'O', 6),
    pack('Metric', 'Double-counted amount', 'Value', todouble(Naive - Combined), 'O', 7),
    pack('Metric', 'Reserved capacity wasted if you reserve BEFORE lifecycle', 'Value', todouble(Spend * Cover * Move), 'O', 8))
| mv-expand R
| project Metric = tostring(R.Metric), Value = todouble(R.Value), O = toint(R.O)
| sort by O asc
| project Metric, Value

content.json:
### Brownfield checklist before changing storage
| Check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Enable **last access time tracking** and run **blob inventory** | Shows which data is really cold before a lifecycle rule moves it |
| Look at **read and transaction** meters per account | Cool/Cold/Archive charge more per read; busy data can cost more after moving |
| Respect **early-deletion periods** (Cool 30, Cold 90, Archive 180 days) | Moving and then deleting early adds a penalty |
| Check **Archive rehydration** needs | Archive retrieval takes hours and has a per-GB fee |
| Pilot on **one account** for one billing cycle | Proves the saving in the bill before rolling out |
| Size reservations on the **post-lifecycle** steady capacity, per region + tier + redundancy | Avoids paying for reserved capacity that lifecycle moved away |
| Exclude accounts planned for **migration, consolidation or deletion** | A reservation outlives the account |

## Compute and AKS
**Virtual machines:** size, state, Hybrid Benefit, non-production running 24/7, Advisor right-size evidence (CPU and memory P95). **Disks and snapshots:** unattached and old. **AKS:** node pools, autoscaler and Spot use.

> CPU and memory utilization comes from Azure Advisor's analysis (columns *CPU P95 %* and *Memory P95 %*, shown where Advisor made a recommendation). VMs without a recommendation have no utilization data here; for those, enable Azure Monitor metrics or VM Insights on the top-cost VMs.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend Power = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus)
| extend Env = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), ''))
| extend OS = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), License = tostring(properties.licenseType)
| extend ['Hybrid Benefit'] = case(OS =~ 'Windows' and License in~ ('Windows_Server','Windows_Client'), 'Applied',
                                   OS =~ 'Windows', 'Not applied', License has 'BYOS', 'Applied (BYOS)', 'n/a')
| extend rid = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
    | extend _rm = tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId), _ix = indexof(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.advisor/recommendations')
    | extend rid = tolower(iff(isnotempty(_rm), _rm, iff(_ix > 0 and tolower(substring(id, 0, _ix)) contains '/resourcegroups/', substring(id, 0, _ix), '')))
    | where isnotempty(rid)
    | summarize ['Advisor action'] = take_any(tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution)),
                ['Advisor annual savings'] = max(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount)),
                ['CPU P95 %'] = max(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.MaxCpuP95)),
                ['Memory P95 %'] = max(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.MaxMemoryP95)),
                ['Advisor target size'] = take_any(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.targetSku)) by rid
) on rid
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Finding = case(
    Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)' and Power =~ 'VM running', 'Non-prod VM running: schedule shutdown',
    Power =~ 'VM stopped', 'Stopped but not deallocated: still billed',
    ['Hybrid Benefit'] == 'Not applied', 'Windows VM without Hybrid Benefit: check licenses',
    isnotempty(['Advisor action']), 'Advisor: act before any commitment', '')
| project ['VM'] = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Region = location,
          Size = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), ['Power state'] = Power, OS, ['Hybrid Benefit'], Environment = Env, Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''),
          Finding, ['Advisor action'], ['Advisor target size'], ['CPU P95 %'], ['Memory P95 %'], ['Advisor annual savings'], ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| extend _s = iff(Finding == 'OK', 1, 0)
| order by _s asc, Finding asc, ['Advisor annual savings'] desc
| project-away _s

## Databases
SQL Database, Managed Instance, elastic pools, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Cosmos DB: size, model (serverless / provisioned / pool), high availability, backup, Hybrid Benefit and non-production use.

> **Utilization:** DTU or vCore use, CPU, IOPS and storage consumption are Azure Monitor metrics, not inventory. Use the *Finding* column to choose which databases to inspect, then check Metrics for those. Advisor recommendations for databases appear in the Recommendations tab.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.sql/servers/databases','microsoft.sql/managedinstances','microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools','microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers','microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers','microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers','microsoft.dbformysql/servers','microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts')
| where not(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and tostring(split(name, '/')[-1]) =~ 'master')
| extend Env = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), ''))
| extend Service = case(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'SQL Database', type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools', 'SQL Elastic Pool',
                        type =~ 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances', 'SQL Managed Instance', type has 'postgresql', 'PostgreSQL', type has 'mysql', 'MySQL', 'Cosmos DB')
| extend Model = case(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and tostring(sku.name) startswith 'GP_S_', 'Serverless',
                      type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and isnotempty(tostring(properties.elasticPoolId)), 'Elastic pool',
                      type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and tostring(properties.capabilities) has 'EnableServerless', 'Serverless', 'Provisioned')
| extend SKU = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', tostring(properties.databaseAccountOfferType), strcat(tostring(sku.name), iff(isnotempty(tostring(sku.tier)), strcat(' / ', tostring(sku.tier)), '')))
| extend ['Storage GB'] = case(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' or type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools', round(todouble(properties.maxSizeBytes) / 1073741824.0, 0),
                              type =~ 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances', todouble(properties.storageSizeInGB),
                              type has 'flexibleservers', todouble(properties.storage.storageSizeGB), real(null))
| extend Resilience = case(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', strcat('Zone redundant: ', tostring(properties.zoneRedundant)),
                           type has 'flexibleservers', strcat('HA: ', tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode)),
                           type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', strcat('Regions: ', tostring(array_length(properties.locations)), ', multi-write: ', tostring(properties.enableMultipleWriteLocations)), '')
| extend Backup = case(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', strcat('Redundancy: ', tostring(properties.requestedBackupStorageRedundancy)),
                       type has 'flexibleservers', strcat('Retention ', tostring(properties.backup.backupRetentionDays), ' days, geo: ', tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup)), '')
| extend License = iff(type has 'microsoft.sql', iff(tostring(properties.licenseType) =~ 'BasePrice', 'Hybrid Benefit applied', 'License included'), 'n/a')
| extend State = coalesce(tostring(properties.state), tostring(properties.status), '')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Finding = case(
    Service == 'SQL Database' and Model == 'Provisioned' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Non-prod provisioned database: consider serverless',
    Service has 'SQL' and License == 'License included' and Service != 'SQL Elastic Pool', 'Hybrid Benefit not applied: check licenses',
    Service in ('PostgreSQL','MySQL') and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)' and Resilience has 'ZoneRedundant', 'HA enabled on non-prod: review',
    Service in ('PostgreSQL','MySQL') and State =~ 'Ready' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Non-prod server running: consider stop schedule',
    Service == 'Cosmos DB' and Resilience has 'multi-write: true', 'Multi-region writes: confirm required', '')
| project Service, Name = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Region = location, SKU, Capacity = tostring(sku.capacity),
          Model, ['Storage GB'], Resilience, Backup, ['License'] = License, State, Environment = Env, Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''), Finding, ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| order by Service asc, Name asc

content.json:
## Network
Public IPs, NAT gateways, load balancers, firewalls, application gateways, VPN and ExpressRoute gateways, Bastion, private endpoints and DDoS plans, with a *Finding* column for unused or review-worthy items.

> Bandwidth, NAT and firewall data-processing use needs the cost views below; the inventory shows what is deployed, not how much traffic passes through it.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.network/publicipaddresses','microsoft.network/natgateways','microsoft.network/loadbalancers','microsoft.network/azurefirewalls','microsoft.network/applicationgateways','microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways','microsoft.network/bastionhosts','microsoft.network/privateendpoints','microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits','microsoft.network/ddosprotectionplans','microsoft.network/frontdoors','microsoft.cdn/profiles')
| extend Env = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), ''))
| extend Kind = case(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'Public IP', type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways', 'NAT Gateway',
                     type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'Load Balancer', type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'Azure Firewall',
                     type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'Application Gateway', type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'VPN / ExpressRoute Gateway',
                     type =~ 'microsoft.network/bastionhosts', 'Bastion', type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints', 'Private Endpoint',
                     type =~ 'microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits', 'ExpressRoute Circuit', type =~ 'microsoft.network/ddosprotectionplans', 'DDoS Protection Plan', 'Front Door / CDN')
| extend SKU = case(type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', tostring(properties.sku.name),
                    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', tostring(properties.sku.tier),
                    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', strcat(tostring(properties.sku.name), ' / ', tostring(properties.sku.tier)),
                    type =~ 'microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' / ', tostring(sku.family)),
                    strcat(tostring(sku.name), iff(isnotempty(tostring(sku.tier)), strcat(' / ', tostring(sku.tier)), '')))
| extend PeStatus = tostring(properties.privateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status)
| extend Detail = case(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', strcat(tostring(properties.publicIPAllocationMethod), ' ', tostring(properties.ipAddress)),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', strcat('Backend pools: ', tostring(coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0)), ', rules: ', tostring(coalesce(array_length(properties.loadBalancingRules), 0))),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', iff(isnotempty(tostring(properties.autoscaleConfiguration)), strcat('Autoscale ', tostring(properties.autoscaleConfiguration.minCapacity), '-', tostring(properties.autoscaleConfiguration.maxCapacity)), strcat('Fixed capacity ', tostring(sku.capacity))),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways', strcat('Subnets attached: ', tostring(coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0))),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints', strcat('Connection: ', PeStatus),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', tostring(properties.gatewayType),
                       type =~ 'microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits', strcat(tostring(properties.serviceProviderProperties.bandwidthInMbps), ' Mbps'), '')
| extend Finding = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and isempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration)) and isempty(tostring(properties.natGateway)), 'Unattached public IP: delete if unused',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways' and coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0) == 0, 'NAT gateway not attached to a subnet',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0) == 0, 'Load balancer with no backend pool',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and coalesce(array_length(properties.loadBalancingRules), 0) == 0 and coalesce(array_length(properties.inboundNatRules), 0) == 0, 'Load balancer with no rules',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls' and SKU =~ 'Premium' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Firewall Premium on non-prod: review tier',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'Review deployment and data-processing charges',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and isempty(tostring(properties.autoscaleConfiguration)), 'Fixed capacity: consider autoscale',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints' and PeStatus !~ 'Approved' and isnotempty(PeStatus), 'Private endpoint not approved: possible orphan',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/bastionhosts' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Bastion on non-prod: confirm still needed',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/ddosprotectionplans', 'DDoS plan: confirm protected VNets',
    '')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project Kind, Name = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Region = location, SKU, Detail, Environment = Env, Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''), Finding, ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| extend _s = iff(Finding == 'OK', 1, 0)
| order by _s asc, Finding asc, Kind asc
| project-away _s

content.json:
## PaaS and application services
App Service plans and apps, Functions, Container Apps, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Hubs, API Management, Redis, AI Search and Azure AI. Capacity, tier, and findings such as empty plans and premium tiers on non-production.

> Executions, requests, throughput and memory use are Azure Monitor metrics per service. Use the *Finding* column to pick targets, then review their metrics before resizing.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.web/serverfarms','microsoft.web/sites','microsoft.app/containerapps','microsoft.logic/workflows','microsoft.servicebus/namespaces','microsoft.eventhub/namespaces','microsoft.apimanagement/service','microsoft.cache/redis','microsoft.cache/redisenterprise','microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices')
| extend Env = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), ''))
| extend Service = case(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', 'App Service plan', type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites', iff(kind has 'functionapp', 'Function App', iff(kind has 'workflowapp', 'Logic App (Standard)', 'Web App')),
                        type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps', 'Container App', type =~ 'microsoft.logic/workflows', 'Logic App (Consumption)',
                        type =~ 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces', 'Service Bus', type =~ 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces', 'Event Hubs',
                        type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'API Management', type has 'redis', 'Redis', type =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices', 'AI Search',
                        strcat('Azure AI: ', tostring(kind)))
| extend SKU = case(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites', tostring(properties.sku),
                    strcat(tostring(sku.name), iff(isnotempty(tostring(sku.tier)), strcat(' / ', tostring(sku.tier)), '')))
| extend Capacity = case(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', strcat(tostring(sku.capacity), ' instance(s), ', tostring(properties.numberOfSites), ' app(s)'),
                         type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps', strcat('replicas ', tostring(properties.template.scale.minReplicas), '-', tostring(properties.template.scale.maxReplicas)),
                         type =~ 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces', strcat(tostring(sku.capacity), ' TU, auto-inflate: ', tostring(properties.isAutoInflateEnabled)),
                         type =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices', strcat(tostring(properties.replicaCount), ' replicas x ', tostring(properties.partitionCount), ' partitions'),
                         isnotempty(tostring(sku.capacity)), tostring(sku.capacity), '')
| extend State = coalesce(tostring(properties.state), '')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Finding = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0, 'Empty App Service plan: delete or consolidate',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Premium plan on non-prod: review tier',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and toint(sku.capacity) > 1 and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Multiple instances on non-prod',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites' and State =~ 'Stopped', 'Stopped app: its plan is still billed',
    type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps' and toint(properties.template.scale.minReplicas) > 0 and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Min replicas above zero on non-prod: scale to zero?',
    type =~ 'microsoft.logic/workflows' and State =~ 'Disabled', 'Disabled workflow',
    type =~ 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces' and tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Premium Service Bus on non-prod',
    type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium', 'API Management Premium: confirm multi-region or VNet need',
    type has 'redis' and tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium' and Env matches regex '(dev|test|qa|uat|sandbox|stag|poc|demo|nonprod|non-prod)', 'Premium Redis on non-prod',
    '')
| project Service, Name = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Region = location, SKU, Capacity, State, Environment = Env, Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''), Finding, ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| extend _s = iff(Finding == 'OK', 1, 0)
| order by _s asc, Finding asc, Service asc
| project-away _s

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| extend Retention = toint(properties.retentionInDays), DailyCap = todouble(properties.workspaceCapping.dailyQuotaGb), Reservation = toint(properties.sku.capacityReservationLevel)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Finding = case(Retention > 90, strcat('Retention ', tostring(Retention), ' days: review (first 31 days are free)'), isnull(DailyCap) or DailyCap < 0, 'No daily ingestion cap', '')
| project Workspace = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Region = location, Tier = tostring(properties.sku.name),
          ['Retention (days)'] = Retention, ['Daily cap GB'] = DailyCap, ['Commitment tier GB/day'] = Reservation, Environment = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), '')), Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''), Finding, ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| extend _s = iff(Finding == 'OK', 1, 0)
| order by _s asc, Finding asc
| project-away _s
content.title: Log Analytics workspaces: tier, retention and caps

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/components'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Retention = toint(properties.RetentionInDays), Workspace = tostring(properties.WorkspaceResourceId)
| extend Finding = case(isempty(Workspace), 'Classic (not workspace-based): migrate', Retention > 90, 'Retention above 90 days: review', '')
| project ['App Insights'] = name, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Subscription = SubscriptionName, Kind = tostring(kind), ['Retention (days)'] = Retention,
          ['Sampling %'] = todouble(properties.SamplingPercentage), ['Ingestion mode'] = tostring(properties.IngestionMode), ['Linked workspace'] = tostring(split(Workspace, '/')[-1]),
          Environment = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), '')), Finding, ['Resource ID'] = id
| extend Finding = iff(isempty(Finding), 'OK', Finding)
| extend _s = iff(Finding == 'OK', 1, 0)
| order by _s asc, Finding asc
| project-away _s

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/pricings'
| extend Plan = name, Tier = tostring(properties.pricingTier)
| where Tier =~ 'Standard'
| summarize ['Paid plans'] = count(), Plans = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(tostring(make_set(Plan)), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '') by subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription = SubscriptionName, ['Paid plans'], Plans
| order by ['Paid plans'] desc

resources

content.json:
## 1-3-6-12 Month Savings Plan
The order matters: **clean up → rightsize → commit → modernize**. Reserving before rightsizing locks in oversized capacity, and adding Advisor's rightsizing and reservation figures for the same VM double counts the saving.

| Horizon | What we do | Typical items |
|---|---|---|
| **1 month** | Quick wins | Delete unattached disks and IPs, empty plans, old snapshots; apply Azure Hybrid Benefit |
| **3 months** | Rightsize | VMs, App Service plans, databases, Log Analytics ingestion and retention |
| **6 months** | Commit | 1-year or 3-year reservations / Savings Plan on the **rightsized** baseline; storage reserved capacity after lifecycle rules |
| **12 months** | Modernize | VM-based services to PaaS or AKS (e.g. Azure DevOps agents), tool consolidation |

**Expected in first 12 months** assumes each horizon is complete by its deadline (1 month = 11 months of benefit, 3 = 9, 6 = 6, 12 = 3 on average) and applies the realization %.

parameters.name: Realization
parameters.label: Planning realization %
parameters.description: Share of Advisor savings you expect to deliver. A planning assumption; agree it with the client.

parameters.name: CommitSubscription
parameters.label: Subscription for commitments (All, or pick one)
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| project value = subscriptionId, label = name, o = 1
| union (resourcecontainers | take 1 | project value = '__ALL__', label = 'All subscriptions', o = 0)
| sort by o asc, label asc
| project value, label

content.json:
### Commitments: 1-year vs 3-year
Use this to decide the term for critical VMs and App Services. A 3-year term saves more but locks in the SKU family and region; pick 1-year where a migration, resize or move to AKS/PaaS is planned.

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
| extend SolLow = tolower(tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution))
| where SolLow has_any ('reserved instance', 'reservation', 'savings plan')
| extend Term = toupper(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.term))
| extend Sku = tostring(coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.vmSize), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.sku), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.displaySKU)))
| extend Region = tolower(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.region))
| extend RRT = tolower(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.reservedResourceType))
| extend Monthly = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)
| extend Service = case(SolLow has 'savings plan', 'Compute Savings Plan', RRT has 'virtualmachine' or SolLow has 'virtual machine', 'Virtual Machines',
    RRT has 'appservice' or SolLow has 'app service', 'App Service', RRT has 'blob' or SolLow has 'blob', 'Storage', RRT has 'sql' or SolLow has 'sql', 'Azure SQL',
    RRT has 'postgres' or SolLow has 'postgres', 'PostgreSQL', RRT has 'mysql' or SolLow has 'mysql', 'MySQL', RRT has 'cosmos' or SolLow has 'cosmos', 'Cosmos DB',
    RRT has 'redis' or SolLow has 'redis', 'Redis Cache', 'Other')
| summarize M1 = max(iff(Term == 'P1Y', Monthly, real(null))), M3 = max(iff(Term == 'P3Y', Monthly, real(null))) by subscriptionId, Service, Sku, Region
| summarize ['1-year Annual Savings'] = round(sum(coalesce(M1, 0.0)) * 12, 0), ['3-year Annual Savings'] = round(sum(coalesce(M3, 0.0)) * 12, 0),
    Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by Service, SKU = Sku, Region
| extend ['Extra from 3-year'] = ['3-year Annual Savings'] - ['1-year Annual Savings']
| extend Guidance = case(['1-year Annual Savings'] == 0 and ['3-year Annual Savings'] == 0, 'No savings figure from Advisor',
    ['3-year Annual Savings'] == 0, 'Only 1-year offered: good fit for workloads that may change',
    ['1-year Annual Savings'] == 0, 'Only 3-year offered: commit only for stable, long-lived workloads',
    'Choose 1-year if a migration or resize is planned within 3 years; otherwise 3-year')
| sort by ['3-year Annual Savings'] desc

content.json:
### Reservation and savings plan recommendations by subscription
Choose **All subscriptions** or one subscription above. The tables below use Azure Advisor, so they cover every subscription in the *Subscriptions* filter at once. For one subscription you also get Azure's **1-year vs 3-year pricing** further down (that pricing service works on one subscription at a time).

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
| where '{CommitSubscription}' == '__ALL__' or subscriptionId == '{CommitSubscription}'
| extend Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution)
| extend SolLow = tolower(Solution)
| where SolLow has_any ('reserved', 'reservation', 'savings plan')
| extend Sku = coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.sku), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.vmSize), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.displaySKU), ''),
         Region = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.region), Term = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.term),
         Qty = coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.displayQty), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.qty), ''),
         LookBack = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.lookBackPeriod), LastUpdated = coalesce(tostring(properties.lastUpdated), '')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by subscriptionId, Solution, Sku, Region, Term
| extend Annual = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount), Monthly = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)
| extend Annual = coalesce(Annual, Monthly * 12)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend Commitment = iff(SolLow has 'savings plan', 'Savings plan', 'Reservation')
| summarize Recommendations = count(), ['Reservation savings'] = round(sumif(Annual, Commitment == 'Reservation'), 0),
            ['Savings plan savings'] = round(sumif(Annual, Commitment == 'Savings plan'), 0), ['Total annual savings'] = round(sum(Annual), 0) by Subscription = SubscriptionName
| order by ['Total annual savings'] desc

content.json:
---
## Savings Tracker
Compares average monthly spend before the program started (baseline) with the last full month, and checks each 1-3-6-12 milestone against plan.

parameters.name: PlanStart
parameters.label: Optimization program start
parameters.description: Month the savings plan started. Spend before this month is the baseline.
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| extend M = dynamic([-8, -7, -6, -5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 0])
| mv-expand M to typeof(int)
| project value = format_datetime(startofmonth(now(), M), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), label = format_datetime(startofmonth(now(), M), 'yyyy-MM'), selected = (M == -3)
| sort by value desc

parameters.name: TargetRealization
parameters.label: Target realization %
parameters.description: Share of Advisor savings the plan commits to deliver.

parameters.name: BaseStart
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| project value = format_datetime(startofmonth(todatetime('{PlanStart}'), -{BaselineMonths}), 'yyyy-MM-dd')

parameters.name: BaseEnd
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type == 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| project value = format_datetime(todatetime('{PlanStart}') - 1d, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

parameters.name: BaselineSpend
parameters.query: {"version": "ARMEndpoint/1.0", "data": "{\"type\": \"{CostType}\", \"timeframe\": \"Custom\", \"dataset\": {\"granularity\": \"None\", \"aggregation\": {\"totalCost\": {\"name\": \"Cost\", \"function\": \"Sum\"}}}, \"timePeriod\": {\"from\": \"{BaseStart}T00:00:00Z\", \"to\": \"{BaseEnd}T23:59:59Z\"}}", "headers": [], "method": "POST", "path": "{CostScopeEffective}/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/query", "urlParams": [{"key": "api-version", "value": "2023-11-01"}], "batchDisabled": false, "transformers": [{"type": "jsonpath", "settings": {"tablePath": "$.properties.rows[*]", "columns": [{"path": "$[0]", "columnid": "value"}, {"path": "$[0]", "columnid": "label"}]}}]}

parameters.name: LastMonthSpend
parameters.query: {"version": "ARMEndpoint/1.0", "data": "{\"type\": \"{CostType}\", \"timeframe\": \"Custom\", \"dataset\": {\"granularity\": \"None\", \"aggregation\": {\"totalCost\": {\"name\": \"Cost\", \"function\": \"Sum\"}}}, \"timePeriod\": {\"from\": \"{LMStart}T00:00:00Z\", \"to\": \"{LMEnd}T23:59:59Z\"}}", "headers": [{"name": "x-finops-seq", "key": "x-finops-seq", "value": "{BaselineSpend}"}], "method": "POST", "path": "{CostScopeEffective}/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/query", "urlParams": [{"key": "api-version", "value": "2023-11-01"}], "batchDisabled": false, "transformers": [{"type": "jsonpath", "settings": {"tablePath": "$.properties.rows[*]", "columns": [{"path": "$[0]", "columnid": "value"}, {"path": "$[0]", "columnid": "label"}]}}]}

    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots'), 'Managed Disks & Snapshots',

    ImpactedField in ('microsoft.sql/servers', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools', 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances'), 'Azure SQL',

    SolLow has_any ('delete', 'unattached', 'idle', 'orphaned', 'unused', 'shutdown', 'shut down', 'snapshot', 'retention'), 'Usage: remove waste',
    SolLow has_any ('right-size', 'resize', 'underutilized', 'scale down', 'sku', 'consolidat'), 'Usage: rightsize',
    'Architecture & modernization')
| extend ResourceName = iff(IsSubLevel, '(subscription-level)', tostring(split(ImpactedResourceId, '/')[-1]))
| summarize Identified = sum(AnnualSavings)
| extend Base = todouble('{BaselineSpend}') / {BaselineMonths}, Last = todouble('{LastMonthSpend}')
| extend Change = Base - Last
| extend R = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Baseline: average monthly spend', 'Value', todouble(Base), 'O', 0),
    pack('Metric', 'Last full month spend', 'Value', todouble(Last), 'O', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'Monthly run-rate reduction vs baseline', 'Value', todouble(Change), 'O', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'Annualized run-rate reduction', 'Value', todouble(Change * 12), 'O', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Still identified by Advisor (annual)', 'Value', todouble(Identified), 'O', 4))
| mv-expand R
| project Metric = tostring(R.Metric), Value = todouble(R.Value), O = toint(R.O)
| sort by O asc
| project Metric, Value

content.json:
## Recommendation register
Every Advisor cost recommendation in the standard structure: **subscription, service, resource group, resource, issue, recommendation, evidence, savings, priority, risk, confidence, required action, status**. Duplicate Advisor records are removed; different resources stay separate.

> **Categories:** *Quick win* (unused or idle), *Right-sizing*, *Rate optimization* (reservations, savings plans, Hybrid Benefit) and *Architectural*.
>
> **Savings stages are not additive.** *Potential* (found by analytics) → *Approved* (accepted by the owner) → *Implemented* (change done) → *Realized* (reduction verified in billing). They are the same savings at different stages, so never add the four together. The **Savings Plan & Tracker** tab holds the initiative register and realized-savings check.

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type == 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where tostring(properties.category) == 'Cost'
| extend _rm = tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId), _ix = indexof(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.advisor/recommendations')
| extend ImpactedResourceId = iff(isnotempty(_rm), _rm, iff(_ix > 0 and tolower(substring(id, 0, _ix)) contains '/resourcegroups/', substring(id, 0, _ix), ''))
| extend Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution), Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem), ImpactedField = tolower(tostring(properties.impactedField))
| extend Sku = coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.sku), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.vmSize), tostring(properties.extendedProperties.targetSku), ''),
         Region = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.region), Term = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.term), LastUpdated = coalesce(tostring(properties.lastUpdated), '')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by subscriptionId, ImpactedResourceId, Solution, Sku, Region, Term
| extend Monthly = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount), Annual = todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount)
| extend Annual = coalesce(Annual, Monthly * 12), Monthly = coalesce(Monthly, Annual / 12)
| extend SolLow = tolower(strcat(Solution, ' ', Problem))
| extend Category = case(SolLow has_any ('reserved', 'reservation', 'savings plan', 'hybrid benefit'), 'Rate optimization',
                         SolLow has_any ('unattached', 'idle', 'unused', 'delete', 'orphan', 'snapshot', 'public ip'), 'Quick win',
                         SolLow has_any ('right-size', 'rightsize', 'resize', 'underutilized', 'downgrade', 'sku', 'tier'), 'Right-sizing',
                         'Architectural')
| extend Service = case(ImpactedField has 'virtualmachines' or ImpactedField has 'compute/disks', 'Compute',
                        ImpactedField has 'storage', 'Storage', ImpactedField has 'sql' or ImpactedField has 'dbfor' or ImpactedField has 'documentdb', 'Databases',
                        ImpactedField has 'web', 'App Service', ImpactedField has 'network', 'Networking', ImpactedField has 'containerservice', 'AKS',
                        ImpactedField has 'cache', 'Redis', ImpactedField has 'subscription' or isempty(ImpactedField), 'Subscription-level commitment', tostring(split(ImpactedField, '/')[-1]))
| summarize Recommendations = count(), ['Annual savings (potential)'] = round(sum(Annual), 0) by Category
| order by ['Annual savings (potential)'] desc

content.json:
## Governance
Ownership, tagging, policy and budgets. Cost can only be allocated and savings approved when every resource has an owner, which is why the register on the Recommendations tab shows *Owner* and *Environment*.

content.query:
resources
| where type !in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions','microsoft.network/networkinterfaces','microsoft.network/networkwatchers','microsoft.compute/disks','microsoft.compute/snapshots')
| extend Owner = coalesce(tostring(tags['Owner']), tostring(tags['owner']), ''), Env = tolower(coalesce(tostring(tags['Environment']), tostring(tags['environment']), tostring(tags['Env']), tostring(tags['env']), '')),
         CostCenter = coalesce(tostring(tags['CostCenter']), tostring(tags['costcenter']), tostring(tags['Cost Center']), ''),
         App = coalesce(tostring(tags['Application']), tostring(tags['application']), tostring(tags['App']), '')
| summarize Resources = count(), ['With Owner'] = countif(isnotempty(Owner)), ['With Environment'] = countif(isnotempty(Env)), ['With CostCenter'] = countif(isnotempty(CostCenter)), ['With Application'] = countif(isnotempty(App)) by subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend ['Owner %'] = round(100.0 * ['With Owner'] / Resources, 1), ['Environment %'] = round(100.0 * ['With Environment'] / Resources, 1),
         ['CostCenter %'] = round(100.0 * ['With CostCenter'] / Resources, 1), ['Application %'] = round(100.0 * ['With Application'] / Resources, 1)
| project Subscription = SubscriptionName, Resources, ['Owner %'], ['Environment %'], ['CostCenter %'], ['Application %']
| order by ['Owner %'] asc
content.title: Tag coverage by subscription (percent of resources with each tag; red under 50%, amber under 90%)
